# Nick Rae

> Commercial pilot and aviation workbook author based in Merced, CA. Publishing FAA-aligned pilot study workbooks on Amazon KDP while building side income to fund flight hours toward a flying career.

Summary refreshed October 26, 2026. Historical flight-hour and revenue figures below retain their stated source dates; they are not live totals.

## About

Nick Rae is a Commercial Instrument Multi-Engine rated pilot with 393.1 flight hours documented in the October 2, 2026 ForeFlight report, working toward a 500-hour planning threshold and eventually the experience required for ATP certification. His main public product lane is FAA-aligned aviation study material on Amazon KDP, including Clearance to Confidence: VFR Radio Calls Workbook. He documents the Flight Funded experiment at nickrae.net and built Pilot AI Tools, an independently run aviation software directory. Aviation resources on this site support ground study; they are not FAA approval, flight instruction, or a promised checkride outcome. OpenClaw is a retired runtime; the dated playbook remains available as a background digital product, not the primary offer.

## Aviation Workbooks (Amazon KDP)

These landing pages explain scope and previews, with separate paperback and Kindle links. Confirm the selected edition, price and availability on Amazon; source-manuscript pagination can differ from retail editions.

- [Private Pilot License Workbook](https://nickrae.net/aviation-workbooks/private-pilot/) — PPL knowledge and oral-exam study, an authentic diversion exercise and free oral scenario cards; paperback and Kindle
- [Instrument Rating Workbook](https://nickrae.net/aviation-workbooks/instrument-rating/) — IFR ground study, a dual-VOR question with source context and a free scenario-pack route; paperback and Kindle
- [The Complete Commercial Pilot Workbook](https://nickrae.net/aviation-workbooks/commercial-pilot/) — ASEL commercial preparation, written and oral study, judgment scenarios and a manuscript sample; paperback and Kindle
- [Multi-Engine Add-On Rating Workbook](https://nickrae.net/aviation-workbooks/multi-engine/) — PA-44-focused add-on study, Vmc, one-engine-inoperative reasoning and manuscript excerpts; paperback and Kindle
- [Clearance to Confidence: VFR Radio Calls Workbook](https://nickrae.net/aviation-workbooks/vfr-radio/) — call-building, simulated ATC exchanges, readbacks and out-loud ground practice; paperback and Kindle

## Bible Puzzle Books (Separate From Aviation)

- [Walk Through the Gospels: Large-Print Bible Word Searches](https://nickrae.net/walk-through-the-gospels/) — Nick Rae; paperback published September 29, 2026; 128 pages, 8.5 × 11 inches; ISBN 9798177956763. 60 distinct puzzles from the Nativity to the empty tomb, 10 × 10 grids with nine words each, 18-point grid letters and supporting text at least 16 point. Optional coordinate-based hidden reflections, a worked example, and 60 full-size answer keys. Scripture references invite the reader’s own Bible; introductions and reflections are original writing, not Scripture quotations. Selective journey, not a complete Gospel harmony.
- [Amazon paperback](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HLJ2F5PH) — $14.99 USD on Amazon.com when checked September 29, 2026; current price and availability may change. This is a separate non-aviation title, not an update to aviation revenue proof.
